build_vinvl_base: build a VinVL base model with a custom BERT config and image feature dimension
build_vinvl_classification: build a VinVLForClassification model with an MLP head and cross entropy loss
build_vinvl_pretraining: build a VinVLForPretraining model with MLM and three-way contrastive loss heads
run_vinvl_forward: run the VinVL model forward pass with input IDs, image features, and attention masks
review_vinvlbase_forward: review the VinVLBase forward method that concatenates text and image embeddings before encoding
